target: 100% completion on the selected PS4 route, with legacy downloads tracked separately

areas.name: Completion Route
areas.location_cue: The PS4 title screen, system storage, and account add-on manager.
areas.note: This area fixes the platform and separates stable completion from storefront history.

levels.1: Confirm the intended release before recording progress.
levels.2: Use the PlayStation 4 release, directly or through PlayStation 5 backward compatibility.
levels.3: Install the PS4 edition, launch it once, and confirm Dancing, Social, Collection, and Custom are available from the normal menu flow.

levels.1: Separate permanent in-game records from account downloads.
levels.2: Treat built-in tracks, Social events, room cards, modifiers, wardrobes, and Collection as the base archive.
levels.3: Complete every base-game area in this pack first. Missing legacy downloads do not reduce base completion and belong only in the separate DLC ledger.

levels.1: Protect the local record before long registry cleanup.
levels.2: Confirm the autosave indicator, then preserve a console backup before the final catalog audit.
levels.3: Exit to the title screen after a visible save, close the game, and copy the save through the console's supported backup method. Record note speed and custom settings separately.

levels.1: Check the owning account before promising downloads.
levels.2: Inspect the PS4 account library and the game's downloadable-content link.
levels.3: Record which P3D/P5D shared tracks and P3D cosmetic packs the account can still install. Mark unavailable regional entries as legacy-unavailable instead of treating them as missing base progress.

areas.name: Collection and Completion Archive
areas.location_cue: Collection, Dancing results, character customization, and Custom.
areas.note: These are stable menu and performance records, not narrative objectives.

levels.1: Review the game's permanent reference pages.
levels.2: Open Collection and complete every Tutorial entry.
levels.3: Play every tutorial through its last prompt. Reopen the list and verify no entry remains marked new or incomplete.

levels.1: A higher chart tier opens through broad catalog progress.
levels.2: Clear the built-in track catalog on any available difficulty.
levels.3: Finish every built-in song once; return to Dancing and confirm All Night can be selected. Then use the track ledger to clear that chart tier across the catalog.

levels.1: Keep opening newly highlighted Social rows.
levels.2: View all eight events for every Social character.
levels.3: Finish all 64 neutral-numbered Social records in this pack, then reopen Social and verify that every character column is complete.

levels.1: Later room visits hide a small physical set.
levels.2: Collect every card from Events 6, 7, and 8 in each explorable character room.
levels.3: Use the 21 individual card records and schematics, then reopen every applicable room or reward list to confirm no blue card remains unclaimed.

levels.1: Social progress supplies most of the stable wardrobe.
levels.2: Complete every Social event and hidden-card reward, then inspect each character's costume tab.
levels.3: After all Social and card records are complete, visit every character in costume setup and clear all new markers. Verify the base costume registry is full; keep legacy downloads in the DLC ledger.

levels.1: Some room rewards fill a dedicated cosmetic group.
levels.2: Claim every room card and inspect the glasses entries for each supported dancer.
levels.3: Collect all 21 room cards, open character customization, and visit each glasses row until every base pair is present and its new marker is cleared.

levels.1: Rotate cosmetics while working through Social gates.
levels.2: Complete all Social rewards, card rewards, and accessory-use thresholds.
levels.3: Finish every Social and card record, then inspect both accessory slots for every dancer. Clear all new markers and verify the built-in accessory registry is full.

levels.1: Different chart tiers reveal partner combinations.
levels.2: Use the partner selector on every track that offers Fever partners.
levels.3: Across the four chart difficulties, choose every available Fever partner for each applicable main dancer and clear the chart. Use Collection or the partner selector to confirm no combination remains hidden.

levels.1: A clean familiar chart is the best test.
levels.2: Earn the highest result grade on one comfortable chart.
levels.3: Choose an Easy chart you know, avoid misses, hit Fever Rings, and finish with enough PERFECT judgments to receive KING CRAZY. Keep the result in the score archive.

levels.1: Use support settings to stabilize a higher chart.
levels.2: Clear Hard or All Night with at least half the notes judged PERFECT.
levels.3: Enable helpful Support modifiers, choose a familiar Hard chart, and finish with PERFECT on at least half of its notes. The result screen must show a clear.

levels.1: Save a representative performance for review.
levels.2: Watch one saved replay from Collection.
levels.3: Finish a chart, save its replay when prompted, open Collection, and play that recording through once. Retain at least one replay as part of the local archive.

levels.1: Return to an early chart after warming up.
levels.2: Beat a previously recorded score.
levels.3: Choose a chart with an existing score, finish it with a higher total, and confirm the personal-best value updates on the selection screen.

levels.1: Give each playable dancer one customized result.
levels.2: Clear a chart with a changed costume on every applicable main dancer.
levels.3: Select each playable main dancer in turn, change the outfit from default, clear one chart, and verify the performance result. Exclude support-only characters that cannot lead a chart.

levels.1: Combine the cosmetic controls once they are available.
levels.2: Start a chart with changed hair, colored contacts, and both accessory slots filled.
levels.3: On any main dancer, change the hairstyle or wig color, set contacts, equip two accessories, and begin a chart. Finish it so the customized state is retained.

levels.1: The Custom page supports opposed assistance and challenge settings.
levels.2: Clear the documented paired and stacked Custom configurations.
levels.3: Complete separate clears for GOOD-preserved combo plus combo-break failure, wavering paths plus fluctuating speed, all Support entries on Hard, and five Support plus five Challenge entries together. Also start All Night once with at least ten Challenge entries active.

levels.1: Finish with the game's own permanent menus.
levels.2: Recheck Dancing, Social, Collection, Custom, and every wardrobe tab.
levels.3: Confirm every built-in chart tier, Social event, card, Custom entry, wardrobe row, partner pairing, tutorial, replay check, and score trial in this pack. Exit only after autosave completes and keep the DLC ledger separate.
